# How many extra appointments should you book?

> Free appointment overbooking calculator for clinics, dentists, salons and studios. Enter your slots, no-show rate or daily booked and showed counts, and what an over-full day costs. Get the profit-maximising number of extra bookings, the chance anyone is over capacity, and how sure the answer is.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
